title: Vintage Tuxedo Scarf
body_html:
What is this? A scarf, technically. But also? A vibe.

This deep burgundy wool-silk number is giving luxury dad, vintage clubroom, and just enough “I golf, but like… stylishly.” Covered in tiny golf bags and finished with preppy stripes, it’s equal parts elegant and eccentric. Think: "country club murder mystery."

A few teeny pulls, but hey, it’s old. So are all the best things (us).

Giftable? Absolutely. Wearable? Weirdly, yes. Dry clean it if you want. Or don’t.

(One of one. You know the drill.)

title: Vintage Tea Pot
body_html:
An homage to the teapot stance we all do on-course.

You know, the one: when we lean on our putter, opposite elbow bent and hand on our hip, leg crossed, just waiting on our friends to clear the green.

This delightful little teapot is just so darn happy to be here we cant get over it. Straight out of the 1950's and made from perfectly in-tact ceramic. 100% usable condition and in very good condition.

title: Vintage Golfer Bobble Head Vase
body_html:
Do you know this man? We're gonna call him Chuck.

Chuck is a simply adorable painted ceramic golfer that collects all your greens fees, or whatever else you have in mind. Chuck's head bounces on a spring as if to agree that you spend too much time and money playing golf. Use his golf bag container to catch coins, tees or pens... even plant a little of that divot souvenir you brought back on your 7 iron.

In perfect working condition, Chuck is a great companion that will nod in agreement with whatever you say.

title: Vintage 1963 Interlachen Dinner Plate Sample
body_html:
This vintage plate sample is a true slice of golf history. Labeled with original marks from 1963, artifact hails from the storied Interachen Country Club, home historic major golf events including the 1930 US Open, won by Bobby Jones, and the USA Championship 2002 Solheim Cup. 

It's a deceptively simple piece that tells a complex story, with its worn decals and the mystery of its half-visible, half-worn-away illustrations. Inscribed with a production number, it's easy to imagine the scrutiny this item must have experienced at the discerning eyes of the club's committee, deliberating its suitability for the elite membership at this historic location.

title: Vintage Megan's Life Story Book
body_html:
This is Megan the CEO - I am the crazy one who buys all this cool vintage stuff. My team makes me put it up for sale, which I guess is a fair thing to do since our office is full enough as it is. 

That said, this one, I don't want you to have. It's too good and speaks to me on a deep personal level.

But since I have to write all the copy for our site (yes, it's true, ALL the words on ForayGolf.com are mine) I can make the rules. Further, I am pretty sure no one on our team is going to double check my work, so I made this one expensive - like REALLY expensive - just so you don't impulse buy it. 

That said, if you DO want to buy this, I will make you a deal. If you purchase my favorite book, I will donate the entire amount ($2,300) to The First Tee Metro  New York(501c3) in your name.

Is it worth it? Well, only if you support kids and the future of our game. But hey, who am I to pressure you. I really don't want to give this one up, but will have no choice if it's for the right reasons.

Better than basic, and a lot more fun. The Abstract Floral Skirt takes our best-selling Core silhouette and prints it with a soft-focus, diffused floral. Fabric

  • Wrinkle resistant, so it comes out of your golf bag or suitcase ready to wear

Construction that stays put

  • Attached Sneaky Pocket shorts hide balls, tees and your phone: no bulging pockets, no digging through your bag
  • Back pocket for your glove, keys or tees
  • Silicone gripper leg openings keep the shorts from riding up
  • Channel gusset construction for a smooth, stay-put fit through the whole round

Fit and length

Fits true to size, so take your normal size. Available in sizes XXS to XXL and two lengths:

  • Regular 15.5": our classic length
  • Tall 17": extra coverage for taller golfers or anyone who prefers a longer hem

Our model is 5'7" and is wearing a Small.

How to wear it

Pull a single color from the print and match it with a solid. The Core Sleeveless Polo in white or navy is the no-fail pairing, and the Core Half Zip finishes the look on cooler days. After your round, it works just as well with a white tee and sneakers.
